title: ProvAssociation
description: Rootless facet — PROV Association: "an assignment of responsibility to an agent for an activity, indicating that the agent had a role in the activity. It further allows for a plan to be specified, which is the plan intended by the agent to achieve some goals in the context of this activity." Composed onto a statement, the statement is the associated activity. Source: W3C PROV-DM (REC-prov-dm-20130430) §5.3.3 Association, wasAssociatedWith(id; a, ag, pl, attrs); PROV-O prov:wasAssociatedWith.

id.description: Optional identifier for this association relation (PROV-DM §5.7.1: two associations are equal if they have the same identifier).

agent.description: The agent associated with the activity (PROV-DM §5.3.3, ag, optional).

plan.description: The plan the agent relied on in the context of this activity (PROV-DM §5.3.3, pl, optional; a plan is an entity, prov:Plan).

attributes.description: Optional set of attribute-value pairs with additional information about this association (PROV-DM attrs; reserved PROV attributes per §5.7.2 — prov:label, prov:type, and prov:role, permitted on Association per §5.7.2.3 — plus application-specific attributes, PROV-DM's extensibility point, §6).

wasAssociatedWith.description: PROV-DM §5.3.3: "While each of id, agent, plan, and attributes is optional, at least one of them must be present." minProperties: 1 over exactly these four members enforces that rule; the mandatory activity (a) is the host statement.
